top_categories.workout_context: 101ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Wish One Millau, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Wish One Millau. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 81, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Wish One Millau's Grands Causses limestone plateaus, UCI Gravel World Series forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 81 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Wish One Millau's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
8,200ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
8,200ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 81 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 81 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Wish One Millau, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
The aerobic base that lets you ride french plateau gravel at tempo for 81 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Wish One Millau’s 81 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Wish One Millau requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on french plateau gravel to build confidence. Expect: grands causses limestone plateaus, uci gravel world series (sole french round), larzac forest gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and G Spot to prepare you for 81 miles of french plateau gravel in Millau, Aveyron, France (Grands Causses).
